Name: More Warp Points v1 (CJB Cheats Menu) (1.5)
Author: juanpa98ar
Description:
[font=Georgia][i][b][size=6][color=#00ffff][u][center]CJB Warp Points[/center][/u][/color][/size][/b][/i][/font][font=Georgia]
[b][i][color=#ffff00][size=6][u][center]This mod was created ONLY for Stardew Valley 1.5, if you use Stardew valley +1.6 you must use this mod:
'[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/23342/]More Warp Points v2[/url]﻿'[/center][/u][/size][/color][/i][/b]


[list]
[*][b][size=5]This mod requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4]CJB Cheats Menu[/url] to work as [color=#ff0000]it replaces files from that mod[/color] to display the new points. [/size][/b]
[*][b][size=5][color=#00ff00]The mod is made so that you only have to unzip it, move the two obtained folders and replace.[/color][color=#ffff00] [/color][color=#ff0000]Installation instructions below.[/color][/size][/b]
[/list][/font][font=Georgia]

[color=#00ff00][size=5][b][i][u]Warps To:[/u][/i][/b][/size][/color]
[list]
[*][font=Georgia][size=4][b][i]Vanilla Game.[/i][/b][/size][/font]
[*][font=Georgia][size=4][b][i]Stardew Valley Expanded.[/i][/b][/size][/font]
[*][font=Georgia][size=4][b][i]East Scarp.[/i][/b][/size][/font]
[*][font=Georgia][size=4][b][i]Ridgeside Village.[/i][/b][/size][/font]
[/list][b][i]
[color=#00ff00][size=5][u]Extras:[/u][/size][/color][/i][/b][list]
[*][font=Georgia][size=4][b][i]Cape Stardew.[/i][/b][/size][/font]
[*][font=Georgia][size=4][b][i]Stardew Aquarium.[/i][/b][/size][/font]
[*][font=Georgia][size=4][b][i]Downtown Zuzu.[/i][/b][/size][/font]
[*][font=Georgia][size=4][b][i]Lunna Astray.[/i][/b][/size][/font]
[*][font=Georgia][size=4][b][i]DeepWoods (Partially).[/i][/b][/size][/font]
[*][font=Georgia][size=4][b][i]Boarding House.[/i][/b][/size][/font]
[*][font=Georgia][size=4][b][i]Durin's Rest.[/i][/b][/size][/font]
[*][font=Georgia][size=4][b][i]Mineral Town.[/i][/b][/size][/font]
[*][font=Georgia][size=4][b][i]Cheat Locations.[/i][/b][/size][/font]
[/list]

[/font][font=Georgia][color=#ffff00][size=6][b][u][i]Important:[/i][/u][/b][/size][/color]
[/font][list]
[*][font=Georgia][size=4][b][i]The mod has all the Warps, regardless of whether you have their respective mods installed. [color=#ff0000]If you use a Warp without having the corresponding mod, [u]the game will break[/u].[/color][/i][/b][/size][/font]
[/list][font=Georgia][size=4][b][i]
[/i][/b][/size][/font][list]
[*][b][i][font=Georgia][size=4][u]There are two versions of the mod[/u]: one for players [color=#00ff00]with SVE[/color] and one [color=#ff0000]without SVE[/color]. Download the version that corresponds to your situation to avoid errors.[/size][/font][/i][/b]
[/list][font=Georgia][size=4][b][i]
[/i][/b][/size][/font][list]
[*][font=Georgia][size=4][i][b]Older versions of the mods (such as mobile versions) may not work or may be buggy.[/b][/i][/size][/font]
[/list][font=Georgia]
[i]
[color=#00ffff][size=6][b][u]Installation:[/u][/b][/size][/color]

[list=1]
[*][font=Georgia][i][size=4][b]Download and install "[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4]CJB Cheats Menu[/url]﻿" [color=#ff0000](Required)[/color].                                                                                      [/b][/size][/i][/font]
[*][font=Georgia][i][size=4][b]Download this mod [color=#ffff00](NO MOD MANAGER)                                                                                                       [/color][/b][/size][/i][/font]
[*][font=Georgia][i][size=4][b]Follow the instructions:[/b][/size][/i][/font]﻿
[/list][/i][/font][i][size=4][b][img]https://i.postimg.cc/pr7GBkc2/gifmaker-me-1.gif[/img]﻿[/b][/size][/i][font=Georgia][i]
[/i][/font][font=Georgia]
[color=#00ffff][size=6][i][b][u]Summary:[/u][/b][/i][/size][/color][size=5] [/size][size=4]When you download this mod and unzip it, you will get two folders: "[color=#00ff00]CJBCheatsMenu[/color]" and "[color=#00ff00]WarpsEnglish[/color]" (If you only get one folder, inside this folder should be the two mentioned folders), you must move them directly to the [color=#ffff00][u][b]Mods folder[/b][/u][/color] of the game. The operation was completed successfully if when moving the folders you are [color=#ffff00]asked to replace them[/color]. [/size]
[/font][font=Georgia][color=#00ffff]

[size=5][u][b][i]Note[/i][/b][/u][/size][/color][color=#00ffff][size=5][u][b][i]:[/i][/b][/u][/size][/color] [size=4]You can click directly on the bar on the right in the Warps menu to go directly to the Warp of your interest. The best way to get around the Warps, at least until there is a way to filter the Warps.[/size]

[b][img]https://i.postimg.cc/3J1dPbQR/gifmaker-me-2.gif[/img][/b][/font]
